subject: Small change for the delivery
text: Hi Professor, I hope your week has been manageable so far. I wanted to check in about the delivery of the prototype boards we discussed last month. Our team has just seen an unexpected change in priorities, because the grant review committee moved our funding update forward to next Tuesday, and we need to spend the weekend preparing evidence rather than assembling boxes. Does it make sense to push the drop-off to late Thursday afternoon? I can bring everything myself if that helps, and I would gladly leave it outside your office if the department front desk is closed. The packaging is now labelled, and the spare cables are tucked into a separate pouch so nobody has to dig through the foam. I know your schedule is already tight, so I am happy to adapt whatever works for you. If Thursday is inconvenient, maybe a morning slot earlier in the week would suit you better. There is no need to reply quickly; I only want to avoid making assumptions. Thanks again for your patience with our little scramble. I have kept the original inventory sheet inside a clear envelope, so you can compare it at your convenience without opening each case. Warmly,
